name: Wei Zhao
bio:
Wei Zhao's fascination with electronics began during his national service, where he maintained sophisticated communications equipment. He channeled this interest into a degree in Electrical Engineering from the National University of Singapore, specializing in embedded systems. After graduation, Wei joined a local automotive engineering firm, working on electric vehicle powertrain development. He quickly distinguished himself with his meticulous approach to problem-solving and an ability to optimize complex electrical systems for performance and reliability.

His entry into motorsport came through a chance encounter with a junior team competing in a regional Formula series. Impressed by his technical acumen, they offered him a role as their electronics engineer. Wei's dedication and innovative solutions led to a noticeable improvement in the team's car performance, catching the eye of Andretti Global. Known for his calm demeanor under pressure, Wei excels at diagnosing and resolving electrical issues quickly and efficiently. His commitment to precision and his ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable strategies make him a valuable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight side part
physical.description: Wei is of average height with a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small multi-tool, even in meetings.
Insists on using a specific brand of soldering iron.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers rhythmically when deep in thought.
